Penumbra Foundation Digitization Internship Program

The Digitization Internship provides the opportunity to gain invaluable artistic and professional skills through experience with artists and their archives. Given the fact that there are many artists’ archives which are at risk of being lost, this internship is an opportunity for interns to play a part in photographic preservation that is invaluable to artists’ careers as well as provide a historical record.

Program Highlights:

  • This 4 month intensive internship provides 2 young artists with the opportunity to digitize a project from an artist’s archive using Penumbra’s new Digitization System, equipped with a FUJIFILM GFX100S II.

  • The artists will give a lecture to the community about the work that is being digitized in the program.

  • Interns will attend 5 educational seminars with industry professionals going over each aspect of digitizing: using the cameras, Capture One, using the Fotocare copystand, archiving vs digitization, and conservation.

  • In addition to their primary digitization project, interns will dedicate 4 hours weekly to the development of personal project. The artists they are paired with will participate in 3 scheduled critique sessions to offer guidance on their in-progress bodies of work.

items.title: Application & Selection Process
items.html:
• Applications are accepted via Jotform. Please click here to apply.

  • The application consists of a resume, cover letter, 2 references, schedule, and a sample of photographic work.

  • The application is FREE.

  • Submissions are reviewed once a year by an outside juror.

  • Please carefully read the instructions in the application form. Applications that are incomplete or do not conform to the requirements will not be considered.

items.title: Intern Requirements/ Qualifications
items.html:
• Applicants must be full-time US residents. Unfortunately, we cannot sponsor visas.

  • This position is fully in-person. Applicants must live in or near NYC.

  • The program requires a commitment of 15 hours per week for four months (240 hours total), Monday through Friday between 10 AM and 6 PM.

  • Applicants should be early in their careers: either in school studying photography or demonstrating an equivalent commitment to a career in photography.

  • 2 references that can verify a history of reliability, communication skills, respect and engagement in a work and/ or learning environment are required in the application.

  • Applicants should have a clear passion for their practice and photography as a whole

  • Applicants must be extremely punctual and communicative

  • Archiving experience is helpful but not required

items.title: Internship Benefits
items.html:
• $4,000 stipend for full participation (+ $500 for transportation and meals)

  • Valuable training and work experience as well as an opportunity to build their professional network

  • Free Penumbra student membership which provides access to PF facilities and events. Interns will be welcome to use facilities to print their own work outside of internship hours.

  • Free film processing at LTI-Lightside for the duration of their internship

  • Interns will gain valuable hands-on experience working with a range of equipment, building practical skills they can carry forward into their careers.
